selection: Regular rounds (09/12/20) rotate one two-keyword group. Legacy mode queries video and image notes from the past week; adaptive mode adds a collect-sorted video variant and ranks remembered sources by audited yield. The 24-hour, five-day and seven-day windows are enforced locally.
coverageNotice: 基于当轮关键词与页数发现选题，未覆盖小红书全部内容。

dailySweep.selection: Once a day at 06:00 Beijing time. Legacy mode searches the first page of every keyword for notes of any type from the past day, sorted by popularity. Adaptive mode searches the priority keywords first and video notes only, then rotates the rest plus remembered sources that can yield today picks. Results only feed the today board.
dailySweep.prioritySource: 2026-09-15 read-only audit of stored 一天内 searches (2026-09-14 06:00 legacy sweep and 2026-09-15 06:00): keywords whose first page held at least one 24-hour note with 1,000 likes, ordered by count. Image-note searches produced 0 of 80, so adaptive sweeps search videos only.
dailySweep.source: Keywords of the old site's 2026-09-10 11:00 today-board run; in two recorded runs no 1,000-like note appeared after page 1.
dailySweep.coverageNotice: 今日热榜来自每天 06:00 的关键词搜索，未覆盖小红书全部内容。
